Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Maple Grove for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events across Maple Grove and Corcoran, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (Breakfast and Lunch with Santa and Santa at The Shoppes at Arbor Lakes) through December 13 (Sensory Santa), with Santa at the Loop (December 12), Sensory Santa (December 13) and Santa and Mrs. Claus at Heidi's Growhaus in Corcoran along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Maple Grove

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Maple Grove, including 1 from Corcoran
  • 3 free events, per the live page, with Santa at The Shoppes at Arbor Lakes listing no price
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast and Lunch with Santa, Santa at the Loop, Sensory Santa and Santa at The Shoppes at Arbor Lakes
  • Parades and tree lightings: a light parade at 4:30 pm and tree lighting at 5 pm at The Shoppes on December 5
